xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:AnyOtherInformationForDisclosu: Communication recevived from NSE on 11.08.2025 & BSE on 29.08.2025
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionTak: As per disclosure submitted on 30th August, 2025, there is an alleged non-compliance with Regulation 17(1A) of the SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015 regarding the appointment of Prof. S. C. Saxena as an Independent Director being over 75 years of age. The stock exchanges (BSE and NSE) have levied a fine of Rs. 25,960 (including GST) each and Rs. 63720 (including GST) each for the quarter ended March, 2025 and June, 2025 respectively. This fine relates to the continued alleged non-compliance across two consecutive quarters — March 2025 and June 2025.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Regulation 17(1A) Non-compliance with the requirements of prior shareholders’ approval pertaining to appointment or continuation of Non-executive director who is already aged above seventy-five years
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: The Company has paid the fine to both the stock exchanges. However, the Company is of the humble opinion that there was no non-compliance on its part as prior approval is applicable in case of continuing NED and that the fine levied by the Exchanges was not appropriate.
